# uyuni_users (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    uyuni = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/svalabs/uyuni"
    }
  }
}

provider "uyuni" {
  host     = "192.168.1.100"
  username = "admin"
  password = "admin"
}

data "uyuni_users" "my_users" {}
```
